story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: New enrollment uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date

flagged.why: the Edge case never tests an error path

gaps: Status field for id TC_TS001_003 is "Edge"

No Test Step Expected Result for id TC_TS001_003 describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record; examples quoted from Test Step Expected Result include "The test file reflects the one-day boundary condition required for this edge scenario: eligibility date 20250125 and earlier assessment-related date 20250124.", "The file processes successfully and policy unit delivery completes, showing the narrow date difference does not block the transaction.", and "The stored FACETS transaction effective date is 2025-01-25 and there is no loaded row using 2025-01-24 as the transaction effective date for this enrollment, proving the later Eligibility Date wins even at the one-day boundary."

scenarios.title: Current eligibility with changed Assessment Date uses Assessment Date

flagged.why: the Edge case never tests an edge condition

gaps: Status field for id TC_TS002_003 is "Edge" but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record; for example step 8 Test Step Expected Result: "The file may process technically, but there is no evidence of a newly changed Assessment Date driving a new transaction effective date update for the member."

scenarios.title: Assessment Date change with no relevant field changes preserves existing relevant field values
Future eligibility with relevant field changes and unchanged Assessment Date uses Eligibility Date
Current eligibility with relevant field changes and unchanged Assessment Date uses Maintenance Date
Regression confirms selective date sourcing prevents improper Maintenance Date usage and downstream finance impact
Multiple incoming dates use the first occurrence for selected transaction effective date source
